title: test: add Rhys's go-live rehearsal click checklist
public_pr_body:
Adds tests/MANUAL-CHECKS-GO-LIVE.md with 35 plain click steps and an expected-result/evidence column for Rhys's rehearsal of candidate #247: ZZ test invoice, exact-text chase approval and double/uncertain sends, paid claims, two-company breaks, AI off/on and owner-only allowance, Xero connect, both accountant invitation types, and blank-company setup/isolation.

Assumptions: test copy only, local mail catcher and controlled inboxes, demo accounting organization/test AI provider, Code prepares and separately reviews the database changes. “ZZ” is the customer/line test label; invoice numbering remains untouched. Includes the missing #239 support-UI condition as a visible failure gate, not a claim that candidate #247 already contains it. Every step remains NOT RUN until evidence is recorded.

Validation: source/UI wording and routes reviewed; 35 unique numbered steps checked for expected-result/NOT RUN evidence cells; git diff --check passed. Documentation-only tests/ change, no runtime tests rerun and no manual clicks or database work performed. Nothing under docs/, no SQL applied, no deploy.
